$comment: Shared VfCard cases. Plain data only. The vocabulary is the historical Vue contract at fd793696f50d3be0fcd3788f0f8f751c63869963. Three slots, so the catalog covers each region alone, each pair, and all three - a single composed case would let a whole region disappear unnoticed. The interactive case is the one section 23 of the M16 plan is about: a consumer control inside a slot must not read as component-owned interaction. VfPanel has no cases here and must not be given any.

propVocabulary.title: string, default undefined. Opens the header and fills the fallback heading. Tested for truthiness, so an empty string opens nothing.

slotVocabulary.header: Replaces the fallback h3 when it renders content. A header slot that renders nothing still opens the wrapper and brings the heading back.
slotVocabulary.body: The default slot. Its presence, not its output, decides whether div.vf-card__body renders.
slotVocabulary.footer: Same keying as the body, and no prop opens it.

cases.title: An empty card: three regions, none of them rendered
The body alone, in its classed wrapper

body.text: Everything in this workspace is shared with your team.

cases.title: A title alone opens the header and fills the fallback heading
A footer with no header and no body: the three regions are independent, not ordered gates
A header slot opens the header on its own, with no title anywhere
A header slot drops the fallback heading even when a title was passed, and the title goes unused
A header slot that renders nothing still opens the wrapper and brings the fallback heading back
The same with no title: an empty header holding an empty heading
The quirk: an empty-string title is falsy, so it renders no header rather than an empty one
An empty default slot still produces its wrapper, which still takes a row and a gap in the flex column
An empty footer slot still produces its wrapper
Header and body with no footer
Body and footer with no header
Header and footer with no body
All three regions, in the order the reference renders them
The compact modifier changes the padding and the column gap
The compact modifier on an empty card, where only the padding is visible
A hostile title is escaped as interpolated content
A consumer class is appended after the canonical classes
A consumer class with no modifier to follow sits in a different position in the list
A consumer style reaches the root
A product data attribute reaches the root and is compared
A consumer role and name reach a section that exposes neither of its own
A consumer control inside the body slot. The component owns no interaction; this content is the consumer's, and the static snapshot must say so
A consumer control in the footer as well, so slot ownership is not proved by one slot alone
